arithmetic.method: Independent exact-rational reconstruction of positive noncancelled order units, 364-day annual means and product/store shares, 91-day network level, prior-year monthly factors, due receipts and ordering constraints.
arithmetic.limits: Chosen demand-proxy scenario arithmetic only; includes pending requests. Timing convention counts lead days from end of Nov30 snapshot. No demand-completeness/model-superiority/frozen-December-holdout/authenticated acceptance.

manual_response_review.current_process: Original question describes recent months of sales broadly. Response says exact rule absent and cannot establish improvement over actual current process.

manual_response_review.local_cost: Actual local Python/pandas/numpy computation and measured 14.192 s full analysis support ordinary computer/no paid routine model service. Computer/electricity costs acknowledged; separate AI build price unknown.
manual_response_review.scope: Held-aside October-November development periods are not the reserved December final acceptance holdout. No full frozen pipeline, authenticated verifier/parent gate or milestone acceptance granted.
